blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — Dengue cases in Northern Samar have more than doubled this year compared with the same period in 2025, prompting Gov. Harris Ongchuan to order intensified surveillance, mosquito-control operations and public awareness campaigns to prevent further infections. The province recorded 966 dengue cases in 2026, more than twice the 447 cases reported in 2025, according to the latest epidemiological report presented by the Department of Health (DOH) to the Provincial Health Board (PHB). Nick Andrew Cardenas of the DOH-Northern Samar reported a significant increase in cases from the first week of July through the third and fourth […]...
